tickets.title: Prepare estate planning note for attorney
tickets.text: Prepare a planning note for the estate attorney covering Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss's adoption of Elia (finalized 2026-01-09), the preferred guardian discussion, successor trustee considerations (currently Casey Lanternmoss), and account ownership information needed before the attorney revises the 2020 will and revocable trust.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that note by 2026-02-10.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss using client-provided updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Add Elia Lanternmoss as a dependent, include Jules's updated Cloudberry Kite School Services benefits information, and reflect the revised monthly spending of about $10,800 after infant care, formula, and medical copays were added.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss's household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents (including Elia), and major recent or expected life events such as the finalized adoption.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record to reflect the $10,800 monthly spending, the six-month cash reserve target while Elia is under age five, and the new dependent.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss given the new dependent and revised spending.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated Lanternmoss household profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to refresh the household profile by 2026-02-03.

tickets.title: Obtain Elia's adoption and identification records
tickets.text: Obtain Elia Lanternmoss's final adoption decree (finalized 2026-01-09), birth certificate (born 2025-10-14), and Social Security number confirmation to support account beneficiary updates and education account paperwork for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss.

tickets.title: Resolve portal upload rejection of adoption decree
tickets.text: Troubleshoot the secure portal rejection of the adoption decree PDF for Elia Lanternmoss, or provide an alternate secure delivery method so Rowan Lanternmoss can submit the document before the 2026-02-05 records deadline.

tickets.title: Complete insurance coverage analysis for Lanternmoss household
tickets.text: Complete an insurance coverage analysis for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss modeling survivor income, mortgage payoff on the $512,000 Portland home, childcare, and education funding assumptions for Elia, given the existing $750,000 employer group life and $500,000 Silver Marmot Insurance individual term policy for Rowan and $300,000 employer group life for Jules.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that insurance coverage analysis by 2026-02-12.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact Rowan Lanternmoss or the insurance professional to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes for the $500,000 Silver Marmot Insurance individual term policy. Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. Obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements before Rowan responds.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements before Rowan responds, due 2026-02-06.

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record discrepancy on Rowan's term policy
tickets.text: Address the beneficiary record discrepancy on Rowan Lanternmoss's $500,000 individual term policy with Silver Marmot Insurance so that Jules Lanternmoss is primary beneficiary and Elia Lanternmoss is included under the updated estate plan structure, replacing the current designation of Casey Lanternmoss as primary.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address that beneficiary record discrepancy by 2026-02-09.

tickets.title: Compare education funding account options for Elia
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of ownership, contribution, and investment options for opening an education funding account for Elia Lanternmoss, including whether grandparents can contribute directly without changing the household's six-month cash reserve target at Teacup Comet Bank.
